title: On-demand daily standup report
description:
## Origin

Discord 2026-09-09 (frendan_braser / Ryan). Need an adaptive on-demand standup they can speak from — not paragraphs.

## Shape

Daily standup with standard questions:

- What I did yesterday
- What I am doing today
- Blockers

Plus likely questions they might get asked. Written like the user might speak; very short bullets.

## Data sources

Consume Kanbus (and optionally Jira-synced) issues, right-now summaries, and recursive rollups. This is the report feature, not a new Jira client.

## Delivery

On demand (CLI + later console). Exact generation, voice, and windows TBD.

## Scope boundary

Do not implement until child epics exist.
